2609.04641.title: A Cost-Aware Agentic Architecture for NL-to-SQL over Nested Enterprise Schemas, with a New Benchmark
2609.04641.paper_summary: Natural-language-to-SQL systems have ad- vanced rapidly on academic benchmarks, yet production enterprise schemas exhibit graph- like, semi-structured, deeply nested structure that current benchmarks do not measure. We make two complementary contributions. First, we introduce the DevRev NL2SQL bench- mark: 900 execution-verified queries with nested-type and link-graph structure, accom- panied by the Semantic Depth Score (SDS), a schema-agnostic rubric for analytical reasoning depth. Second, we present a cost-aware single- generation agentic architecture whose schema- selection, metadata-retrieval, and error-repair components are designed for the requirements this regime imposes. On the DevRev NL2SQL benchmark the system attains 91.7% answer correctness, a margin of 54.6 percentage points over the next-best baseline; on the Spider 2.0 Snowflake public dataset, it is competitive with leading systems at a single-generation operating point.
2609.04641.paper_summary_zh: 自然語言到SQL的系統在學術基準上迅速進步，但生產企業的架構呈現出圖形狀、半結構化和深度嵌套的結構，而目前的基準並未測量這些特徵。我們做出兩項互補的貢獻。首先，我們介紹了DevRev NL2SQL基準：900個執行驗證的查詢，具有嵌套類型和鏈接圖結構，並附帶語義深度分數（SDS），這是一個與架構無關的分析推理深度標準。其次，我們提出了一種成本感知的單一生成代理架構，其架構選擇、元數據檢索和錯誤修復組件是根據這一體系所施加的要求設計的。在DevRev NL2SQL基準上，該系統達到了91.7%的答案正確率，超過下一最佳基準54.6個百分點；在Spider 2.0 Snowflake公共數據集上，它在單一生成操作點上與領先系統競爭。
